title: Campus Crumb - three-minute BizFlow visual walkthrough

steps.title: 1. One owner prompt
steps.body: The owner asks BizFlow to check this month's records and prepare everything needed to act.

steps.title: 2. Departments collaborate
steps.body: Departments run in a documented handoff chain and report evidence after each action.

steps.title: 3. Supplier comparison
steps.body: Supplier research is scored by code. Unavailable listings and material substitutes are never recommended.

steps.title: 4. Daily brief
steps.body: The owner receives checked metrics, data-quality findings, and prioritised actions with evidence.

steps.title: 5. Simulated customer chat
steps.body: A synthetic customer orders two cookies, accepts one configured add-on, and confirms the cart.

messages: I want 2 cookies for pickup at 12:30.
One configured iced lemon tea add-on is available.
Confirmed total: MYR 16.50. Synthetic order only.

steps.title: 6. Stock and owner controls
steps.body: The confirmed order writes a stock-ledger entry. Allergy requests, refunds, and consequential decisions are escalated or simulated.

visual.title: Owner controls
visual.body: Stock ledger updated · allergy escalated · MYR 5.00 refund simulated · MYR 25.00 refund needs owner approval

steps.title: 7. Social campaign
steps.body: The campaign planner produces a one-week set of platform drafts. Nothing is posted automatically.

visual.body: Granola Bar — check today's Campus Crumb menu and message us to order.

steps.title: 8. People department
steps.body: The People department creates a fair-worded synthetic job ad and hiring kit using the owner-set pay range.

visual.body: MYR 12.00–15.00/hour · owner confirms compliance before posting

steps.title: 9. Marketplace seller
steps.body: The seller-side processor validates orders, recomputes totals, prepares a simulated label, and summarises reviews.

visual.body: MP-20261010-0003 · received → confirmed → packing → shipped → completed

steps.title: 10. Owner approval
steps.body: BizFlow ends with drafts and evidence. The owner approves, edits, rejects, or pays; BizFlow never moves real money.

visual.title: Final owner review
visual.body: Approve / reject / mark paid / mark received · no real payment or posting
